text:
The wavefunction is  

\[
\psi(x)=\frac{a}{\sqrt{1+x}}-\frac12 i ,\qquad 1\le x\le 3,
\]

and zero elsewhere (since no particles are found outside \(1\le x\le 3\)).  
Normalization requires  

\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} |\psi(x)|^{2}\,dx = 1
\Longrightarrow \int_{1}^{3} |\psi(x)|^{2}\,dx = 1 .
\]

Compute the modulus squared:

\[
|\psi|^{2}= \left(\frac{a}{\sqrt{1+x}}-\frac12 i\right)
           \left(\frac{a}{\sqrt{1+x}}+\frac12 i\right)
         = \frac{a^{2}}{1+x}+\frac14 .
\]

Now integrate:

\[
\int_{1}^{3}\!\left(\frac{a^{2}}{1+x}+\frac14\right)dx
= a^{2}\!\int_{1}^{3}\!\frac{dx}{1+x}+ \frac14(3-1)
= a^{2}\big[\ln(1+x)\big]_{1}^{3}+ \frac12
= a^{2}\big(\ln 4-\ln 2\big)+\frac12
= a^{2}\ln 2+\frac12 .
\]

Set this equal to 1:

\[
a^{2}\ln 2+\frac12 = 1 \quad\Longrightarrow\quad a^{2}\ln 2 = \frac12 .
\]

Thus  

\[
a^{2}= \frac{0.5}{\ln 2}\approx\frac{0.5}{0.693147}=0.720\;,
\qquad
a = \sqrt{0.720}\approx 0.85 .
\]

The value that matches the options is **0.85**.

**Answer: B**.
